source_backed_requirements: Identity pre-verified by IVR; customerNumber passed as call variable
All temporal operations use call time now
Full currency names mandatory: Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini
Card privacy: never speak more than last 4 digits
Third silence exact termination: Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.
Angry caller: 3 calming replies then transfer to agent
Out-of-scope routing offer: Size bu konuda yardımcı olamıyorum. Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?
Statement week change requires preview then explicit confirmation
Statement PDF send limited to latest statement and registered email

unresolved_conflicts.issue: No backend entitlement pre-check for statement week change; service mutation is authoritative.
unresolved_conflicts.safe_fallback: Proceed with statement.week.decide preview and require explicit customer consent before mutation.

unresolved_conflicts.issue: Physical PBX transfer routing unexposed in voice API contract; terminal intent recorded via dialogue.
unresolved_conflicts.safe_fallback: Announce transfer and use end_call node.

limitations: Only latest statement PDF supported; past statements rejected per business rule.
Masked test card digits limit last-six disambiguation; handled via card names.
